note: Per-clip stems — one SFX clip per video clip. out_s extended by crossfade_s for S-curve bleed.

stems.label: Scene_01A — Hook
stems.prompt: Hard glitch stinger, then a beat of near-silence; deep quiet night-forest pressure, a faint low pulsing heartbeat texture under the skin reveal

stems.label: Scene_02A — Hook
stems.prompt: Cloud-forest night ambience: gentle stream water, night insects, soft breeze through leaves, low and unobtrusive under narration

stems.label: Scene_02B — Hook
stems.description: Intimate uncanny wonder as the illusion breaks
stems.prompt: Same cloud-forest ambience continuing, insects and stream water, a subtle shimmering undertone introduced as the transparent belly is revealed

stems.prompt: Deep low-frequency ambient hum, faint reflective crystalline shimmer/chime texture representing the mirrored organ pouches, distant cloud-forest stream and insects gradually thinning out

stems.label: Scene_03B — Rising Crisis
stems.description: Suspenseful hush breaking into an anomaly reveal

stems.label: Scene_04A — Rising Crisis
stems.prompt: Soft ambient whoosh/map-animation swell tone with a subtle low synth pad, no diegetic forest sound yet — establishes geographic scale

stems.label: Scene_04B — Rising Crisis

stems.label: Scene_04C — Rising Crisis

stems.label: Scene_04D — Rising Crisis
stems.prompt: Daytime forest quiet, soft birdsong, gentle wind through leaves, insects fading

stems.label: Scene_04E — Rising Crisis

stems.label: Scene_04F — Rising Crisis

stems.label: Scene_05A — Peak Crisis

stems.description: Mounting tension, scientific suspense building toward the paradox
stems.prompt: Low tension drone, a pulsing whooshing blood-flow texture building in intensity, a brief silence beat before 'consider what should happen next,' then a subtle rising undertone

stems.label: Scene_05C — Peak Crisis

stems.label: Scene_06D — Climax
